installCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -d frontend ]; then cd frontend; fi; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git /tmp/flutter; export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH"; flutter --version; flutter pub get'
buildCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -d frontend ]; then cd frontend; fi; export PATH="/tmp/flutter/bin:$PATH"; flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_URL=${API_URL:-https://api.example.com}'
